summary.headline: Nazara Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue INR 429 crore and EBITDA INR 46 crore, with a PAT loss of INR 82 crore; Bluetile/BestPlay acquisition restructured to $303 million all-cash.
summary.overview: Consolidated revenue was INR 429 crore and EBITDA INR 46 crore, with a PAT loss of INR 82 crore driven by associate losses (about INR 62 crore share of loss) and impairment, mainly on the Moonshine remnant value. Excluding NODWIN's deconsolidation, comparable revenue grew about 9% YoY. Gaming revenue rose 14% YoY to INR 275 crore at a 19.5% EBITDA margin, with heavier user acquisition spend compressing margins at Bluetile, Kiddopia and Curve. Management restructured the Bluetile and BestPlay deal to a fixed $303 million all-cash price, with $89 million at closing and $214 million by 1 April 2027, and named Bluetile founder Raymond Stauffer as Nazara CEO from 1 September 2026.

financial_highlights.change: Largely share of associate losses and impairment

financial_highlights.value: INR 518 crore revenue, INR 55 crore EBITDA
INR 53 crore, EBITDA INR 14 crore (27% margin)
INR 34 crore, EBITDA INR 11 crore (33% margin)

segments.name: Mobile Gaming (Bluetile and BestPlay)
segments.commentary: Revenue grew 54% YoY but EBITDA was flat as UA spend rose from 78% to 85% of revenue; Bluetile EBITDA margin fell to about 11% from 17.6% a year earlier. Revenue net of UA rose from INR 73 crore to INR 80 crore.

segments.name: Kiddopia / Animal Jam
segments.commentary: Kiddopia revenue grew 19% YoY on higher UA spend with 24-month LTV/CAC trending up; Animal Jam revenue grew 11% YoY.

segments.name: Fusebox Games
segments.commentary: Revenue INR 82 crore, up 12% YoY; Love Island ranked #1 in free apps and #5 in top-grossing apps in the US. Big Brother and The Traitors are the next growth drivers.

segments.name: Curve Games (PC and Console publishing)
segments.commentary: Revenue INR 53 crore and EBITDA INR 14 crore (27% margin), down from about 40% last financial year; more than 60% of development spend went to new signings and releases start from Q2 FY27.

segments.name: Offline gaming (SMAAASH, Funky Monkeys)
segments.commentary: Revenue INR 34 crore and EBITDA INR 11 crore (33% margin); Funky Monkeys revenue grew 58% YoY. SMAAASH 2.0 first reinvention targeted at Lower Parel, Mumbai, in Q4 FY27.

segments.name: AdTech (Datawrkz, Space & Time)
segments.commentary: Datawrkz revenue INR 126 crore with EBITDA INR 3 crore. Management said 60-80% of AdTech revenue is pass-through, so revenue growth does not translate directly into EBITDA.

segments.name: Absolute Sports (Sportskeeda, Pro Football Network)
segments.commentary: Revenue INR 28 crore and EBITDA INR 1 crore; Sportskeeda turned EBITDA positive on lower costs, and Pro Football Network posted a 19% EBITDA margin versus break-even in Q1 FY26.

segments.name: NODWIN Gaming
segments.commentary: Q1 is the seasonally weakest quarter with stable revenue and losses substantially lower YoY; organic growth target 30%+ for FY27, with IPO readiness in progress and Comic Con expanding to 14 Indian events.

guidance_outlook: Bluetile and BestPlay to be consolidated from Q2 FY27 subject to final closing; management expects full economics after closing.
No Nazara-level revenue, EBITDA or margin guidance given at this point.
Curve Games expects new titles to lift margins in later quarters; Sovereign Tower launching this week, Dragon Shelter in September 2026, further unannounced titles before year-end.
NODWIN targeting 30%+ organic growth for FY27.
Offline capital commitment across SMAAASH and Funky Monkeys is about INR 50 crore; no further capital allocation decided until SMAAASH 2.0 product-market fit is seen.
Sportskeeda revenue expected to rise in Q2-Q4 with the US sports season.
capex_capacity: Bluetile and BestPlay: $303 million fixed all-cash; $89 million at closing, $214 million in tranches by 1 April 2027 (about $75 million due in 90 days, about $35 million in December 2026, balance before 1 April 2027).
Bluetile holds roughly $20 million of cash on its balance sheet post-acquisition, available to fund the consideration.
SMAAASH 2.0 Lower Parel implementation to start soon, launch expected January-March 2027.
Offline commitments (SMAAASH and Funky Monkeys including stake increase) about INR 50 crore, funded by internal accruals, debt and Nazara capital infusion.
NODWIN raising $100-200 million, including pre-IPO participation; IPO process ongoing.
demand_pricing: Bluetile increased paid UA spend on new games and features after strong ROI on campaigns; management says growth is UA-driven and margin is deferred, not sacrificed.
Management says no caps on UA spend while LTV/CAC guardrails hold.
Human: Fall Flat transaction sales rose YoY; For The King II showing upside in recent months.
Badlands Crew has sold about 50,000-60,000 copies, in line with expectations. Dragon Shelter has about 130,000 Steam wishlists, exceeding expectations.
Curve's new releases will have no in-app purchases forecast; revenue expected from unit sales only. Management does not expect breakout results comparable to Human: Fall Flat (60 million units).
Sportskeeda faced continued Google traffic challenges; diversifying traffic and distribution, and building the Pro Football Network tools business.
